_note: Spoken AI disclosure (FR-09, D-18): played after the teacher's greeting and before every catch-up script, in the family's language; the written transcript starts with the same line. The computer voice never says names (D-50). te is from docs/design/P1-listen.md; kn, ta and hi are drafts translated from the English for Monika and native review (T-26). Changing a line makes a new clip automatically (the clip is keyed by the wording).

languages.en: This is a lesson from your child's teacher. The rest is read by a computer voice.
languages.te: ఇది మీ బిడ్డ టీచర్ పంపిన పాఠం. మిగిలినది కంప్యూటర్ గొంతు చదువుతుంది.
languages.kn: ಇದು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಗುವಿನ ಟೀಚರ್ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದ ಪಾಠ. ಉಳಿದದ್ದನ್ನು ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಧ್ವನಿ ಓದುತ್ತದೆ.
languages.ta: இது உங்கள் குழந்தையின் ஆசிரியர் அனுப்பிய பாடம். மீதியை கணினிக் குரல் படிக்கும்.
languages.hi: यह आपके बच्चे की टीचर का भेजा हुआ पाठ है। बाकी हिस्सा कंप्यूटर की आवाज़ पढ़ेगी।
